thread:
Maya R: FYI I'm starting onboarding for a community Mistral variant. PR is up: #3421. Weights are in s3://redwood-models/mistral/mistral-lite-7b/2026-02-28 (sha256: 7f3b...ac9).

Maya R: Quick checklist I need help with: license gating (model card + allowed use), tokenizer quirks (BOS/token id mismatch), serving config validation (dedicated vs hosted). cc @Eli (owner)

Eli: I pulled the weights and checked the checksum, looks good. Re: tokenizer — their tokenizer uses a <|bos|> token ID 1 but our loader expects 0 for bos. When we run tokenization we get shifted inputs (off-by-one). I tracked the vocab: first 3 tokens are ["<pad>", "<bos>", "<eos>"].

Eli: Short term patch: in the preprocess layer set `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"bos_token":"<|bos|>","pad_token":"<pad>"})` or remap ids with `tokenizer._convert_id_to_token = lambda i: mapping[i]` (ugly but quick). Long term we should fix the tokenizer config in the model repo.

Maya R: thanks. Would we expect generation issues if we just remap? any safety implications?

Simon T: Licensing note from legal: this model is listed under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 in their model card. That NC (non-commercial) clause means we cannot expose it via our hosted public API for general customers. It can be used for internal experiments or on Dedicated/Private where we can enforce contractual restrictions.

Simon T: Action items for legal gating: 1) model_card.md in repo with explicit license string; 2) attribution line + source link; 3) intake form for exceptions if product team wants hosted exposure -> https://redwood-internal/legal/license-intake :eyes:

legal-bot: LICENSE-REVIEW required. Please file license intake and attach model_card.md + link to weights and checksum. See template: https://redwood-internal/legal/model-card-template.md

Anika: Ops side — if legal approves for Dedicated/Private only, we need the serving config adjusted before merge. Example config snippet we need in the onboarding manifest:

```
{
  "model": "mistral-lite-7b",
  "weights_path": "s3://redwood-models/mistral/mistral-lite-7b/2026-02-28",
  "license": "CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0",
  "allow_hosted": false,
  "allow_dedicated": true,
  "tokenizer_overrides": {"bos_token": "<|bos|>", "pad_token": "<pad>"}
}
```

Anika: Also need a unit test that runs a few tokenization roundtrips and a small generate smoke test (<= 16 tokens) so we catch the bos/pad shift in CI.

Eli: I'll add tokenizer override to the manifest and push a small test to the PR.

Maya R: Simon/Legal — what's the minimal attribution text we should include in model_card? Simon?

Simon T: Use this as a starting point: "Model weights provided by Mistral AI, licensed under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0. Used under terms of that license. Attribution: \"Mistral AI (https://mistral.ai)\""

Maya R: Perfect. I'll add model_card.md with that attribution and the license section, plus the weights checksum and tokenizer notes.

triage-bot: Checklist: [x] weights checksum verified by Eli, [ ] model_card.md added, [ ] license intake submitted, [ ] serving manifest + tests, [ ] legal sign-off.

Anika: Ping @eng-ml for code review once PR has tests + card. If legal sign-off requires an NDA/special contract for hosted exposure, ops will need lead time to provision Private-only configs.

Maya R: Thanks everyone — I'll update PR #3421 with the card, tokenizer fix, and the manifest. Will @mention once all done. :thumbsup:

Eli: quick note for reviewers: tokenizer change is non-invasive — only sets `bos_token`/`pad_token` in tokenizer.json and adds a tiny CI tokenization test.

Simon T: If anyone wants to follow up on license exceptions, DM me or use the intake link.

Maya R: ending thread — will post final status when merged.
